function.name: verify_identity
function.description: Check the caller's date of birth against the account found by lookup_customer. Call only after lookup_customer's sentence asked for the date of birth. Its result is the sentence for the caller (already spoken, or read out word for word when spoken is false); with intent claim_status it also gives a short summary of the claims on the account when it can (it names the claims it reads by their last three digits and says how many more are on file); when that read fails, its sentence only says the caller is verified.

dob_month.description: Month of birth as a number from 1 to 12, as the caller said it.

dob_day.description: Day of the month of birth, from 1 to 31, as the caller said it.

dob_year.description: Year of birth as four digits, as the caller said it.

intent.description: What the caller has said they want: claim_status to hear where their claims stand or what they still need; file_claim to report a new loss or start a claim; other for anything else, such as having something emailed, or when they have not said.

messages.content: Thanks for bearing with me, almost there.
Sorry, I'm having trouble checking that right now. I can have a representative call you back, or we can try again. Which would you prefer?
